verdict.rationale: Gecko offers one narrow, user-configurable event rule of its own. On pull-request scans you set a fail-on severity threshold, and Gecko automatically posts a pass/fail check back to GitHub or GitLab. Webhooks only push events to your own systems, where you would build the actions yourself, so they are a building block and earn no credit here. Scan schedules are recurring, not event-triggered. missing for 10: a general rule engine with custom event conditions mapped to configurable actions (e.g. auto-ticket or auto-fix on a critical finding), documentation of rule configuration beyond the PR-check threshold, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: **Fail-on severity**: the severity threshold that fails the check (for example, fail on High and above).
Gecko posts a pass/fail check back to GitHub or GitLab so reviewers see the security status inline.
